subject: [PATCH v3 2/2] mm/vmscan: consolidate promo vs. high watermark checks

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch consolidates the checks for the watermark that kswapd reclaims zones up to into a single helper function, reducing code duplication and improving maintainability. The function, `kswapd_wmark_pages`, determines whether to use the promo or high watermark based on the NUMA balancing mode. This change has no functional impact but simplifies the codebase by removing redundant checks.
